notes.title: [Update List 2019/8/27 ver1.3.1 Changes]
notes.content:
◆Additional Features
-The EVO2019 Champion was added to the Credits.
-If you purchased Color Set: Type A, you can now select Area colors 5~10.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932357/d8d32aa6d84b1d625b29605859f34b4419350134.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932357/59b9e4bb47252c84a946398b28c37b947aeea094.png

◆Game Balance
Area
-Lowered the hit recovery of [Emulator] when hit.
-Increased the movement speed of Cancer when using [Upload] and [Download].

◆Bug Fixes
General
-Fixed an issue where Sharon’s bullet count would not display properly in Training Mode when changing characters after a certain amount of time has passed.
Area
-Fixed a bug where she would gain too much Super Gauge when performing a regular throw.
-Fixed a bug where she would gain too much Super Gauge when connecting with [Emulator].
-Fixed an issue where the move [Thunder Break] was not properly mentioned as being a follow-up attack for [Humming Rush] on the command list.

notes.title: [Update List 2019/7/17 ver1.3.0 Changes]
notes.content:
Character Changes

Additional Characters
-> Area
*Area does not have any Expert Mode challenges.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932357/f1a49aad55be7321c676e555e81890671dc0ee9b.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932357/6d677ed843d4ce29aed79f8edb058bcf89f39c3b.png

Improvements to Netplay Matches
-> The Netplay has been improved, along with additions and adjustments to the UI.

New Online Mode added for Testing.
-> A mode that allows you to spectate matches (Spectator Mode) has been added
*For PS4 and Steam versions only.

Spectator Mode (In Testing)
This mode allows a Player to create a Lobby and spectate the matches of other Players who join.

Game Balancing

The input for Shirase, Sanane, and Hokuto’s special move 「Ryuusui」has been standardized, and the startup has increased.

Bug Fixes and Balancing

Fixed an issue with Sharon where using Half Moon does not trigger the Critical Gougi.

notes.title: [Update List 2019/4/11 ver1.2.2 Changes]
notes.content:
◆Fixes
-A part of Sharon’s ending message was fixed.

▼The previous message read:
　Sharon had taken back her time with her lover.
　During the mission, she had learned that
　her real name was "Seren".
　However, there was need for that name anymore.
　Because next to Sharon stood her precious lover.

▼The fixed message reads:
　Sharon took back her time with her lover.
　During the mission, she learned that
　her real name was "Seren".
　However, there was no need for that name anymore
　because her precious lover stood next to her.

▼Affected Languages
　English
　French
　Italian
　German
　Spanish
　Russian
　Arabian
　Brazilian Portuguese

-Fixed an issue where the ground would raise up on the Intercontinental Railway stage.

◆Balance Changes

Sharon
-Crash Kick (f+HK) had its overall frames extended.

Terry
-stHP had its overall frames extended.
